title: Floral Print Midi Dress
description: A flowing floral midi dress perfect for summer occasions. Features a V-neckline, adjustable waist tie, and a delicate print on breathable fabric.

title: Classic Crepe Bag
description: A timeless classic abaya crafted in lightweight crepe. Clean lines, subtle button detail, and an open-front cut — effortlessly elegant for everyday wear.

title: Wide-Leg Linen Trousers
description: Relaxed wide-leg trousers in a breathable linen blend. High-waisted with side pockets, tailored to move with you in the Egyptian heat.

title: Embroidered Occasion Dress
description: A statement occasion dress with delicate floral embroidery on the bodice. Fitted silhouette with a flared skirt — made for weddings, engagements, and celebrations.

title: Ribbed Knit Crop Top
description: A soft ribbed knit crop top with a square neckline. Versatile enough to pair with high-waisted trousers or layer under a blazer.

title: Pleated Satin Midi Skirt
description: A fluid pleated midi skirt in lustrous satin. Elegant drape with a comfortable elastic waistband — easy to dress up or down.

title: Structured Double-Breasted Blazer
description: A sharp double-breasted blazer in a neutral tone. Padded shoulders, fitted cut, and a polished finish — the kind of piece that elevates everything underneath.

title: Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Delicate faux pearl drop earrings with gold-tone hardware. Lightweight and elegant — the finishing touch for any outfit.

title: Satin Column Evening Gown
description: A sweeping satin column gown with a low back. Floor-length, bias-cut, and minimal — for evenings that deserve something extraordinary.

title: Printed Silk Scarf
description: A luxurious printed silk scarf in an abstract botanical pattern. Wear as a headscarf, tie around the neck, or knot through a bag handle.

title: Embroidered Open Abaya
description: An open-front abaya with embroidered cuff and hem detail. Lightweight chiffon overlay, available in black and midnight navy.

title: Structured Leather Tote
description: A structured leather tote with a clean rectangular silhouette. Spacious main compartment, interior zip pocket, and top handles — built for daily elegance.

title: Linen Kaftan Dress
description: A relaxed kaftan-style dress in washed linen. Wide sleeves, side slits, and a tie waist — effortlessly cool for warm Egyptian evenings.

title: Velvet Belted Abaya
description: A luxurious velvet abaya with a self-tie belt at the waist. Rich texture, subtle sheen, and a fluid drape — made for special occasions.

title: Oversized Linen Blazer
description: An oversized linen blazer with dropped shoulders and patch pockets. Wear open over a slip dress or buttoned as a standalone top.

title: High-Waist Palazzo Trousers
description: Sweeping palazzo trousers in a lightweight crepe. High-waisted with a wide waistband and full-length legs — elegant movement with every step.

title: Off-Shoulder Poplin Top
description: A crisp off-shoulder top in cotton poplin. Elasticated neckline, slightly billowy sleeves, and a tucked-in length — pairs perfectly with tailored trousers.

title: Wide Gold Cuff Bracelet
description: A bold wide cuff bracelet in brushed gold-tone metal. Slightly adjustable opening, smooth curved profile — a statement piece worn alone or stacked.

title: Maxi Wrap Dress
description: A floor-length wrap dress in a soft jersey fabric. Adjustable fit, V-neckline, and a flowing silhouette that flatters every figure.

title: Silk Slip Cami Top
description: A minimalist silk-touch cami with thin adjustable straps and a bias-cut hem. Layer under a blazer or wear alone for understated elegance.
